listings.title: Sidekick Decaf
listings.description:
Sidekick is Frequent Coffee's most popular daily driver, a smooth and reliable medium roast decaf that earned 92 points from Coffee Review in September 2026. The panel scored it a 9 for body and a 9 for flavor, praising its chocolate, nut, and caramel sweetness with enough citrus to keep the cup lively.
Sourced from smallholder farmers of the Asprotimana Cooperative, this coffee undergoes a washed process at origin before being decaffeinated using the sugarcane EA method.
🌎 Origin: Huila, Colombia
⚗️ Process: Washed + Sugarcane EA Decaf
🔬 Variety: Caturra + Castillo + Variedad Colombia
⛰️…

listings.title: Finca El Paraiso Lychee Peach Decaf
listings.description:
With one of the widest selections of specialty decaf around, Frequent Coffee explores a range of origins, processes, and decaffeination methods, treating decaf as a craft in its own right.
This decaf comes from Diego Samuel Bermúdez and family at Finca El Paraíso in Timbío, Cauca, Colombia, a farm known for its research-driven approach to processing. The cherries went through a yeast-inoculated, 36-hour anaerobic fermentation, followed by washing, thermal shock, and sugarcane EA decaffeination.
Expect notes of peach, lychee, apple, and creamy caramel sweetness.
🌎 Origin: Timbío, Cauca,…

listings.title: Felloween VI
listings.description:
Straight from the resting place of Gedeb, Ethiopia, Felloween VI comes from the Chelbesa station, where 672 smallholder farmers grow coffee at a bone-chilling 2,173 MASL.
To perform its dark magic, whole cherries endure three excruciating days of dry fermentation before being laid out on raised beds to bake in the sun for 16 to 21 days, with daily turning as they slowly dry. The result is a rich, dessert-like cup with plenty of berry-and-cream sweetness.

listings.title: Dona Tea Library
listings.description:
This is the full Dona experience, from a women-run estate in Upper Assam to whole-leaf oolong grown at up to 1,400m in Himachal Pradesh. Every tea, herb and spice is equitably sourced and traceable to its origin, and the sourcing map shows where each one comes from. Try Amber Assam and Hojicha, or Rose is my Name and Himalayan Chamomile, and find your new daily cup.
📦 Includes: 36 sachets (2 of each of the 18 teas) + Sourcing Map
🫖 Black / Oolong: Amber Assam, Grayscale, Heartbeat, Marrakesh, Rose is my Name, Palampur Oolong
🍃 Green / White: Hojicha, Rising Green, Supertwist, Wah White…

listings.title: Olympia Holiday Blend
listings.description:
Olympia’s Holiday Blend is made for the table you set this time of year. Washed and natural lots of Caturra, Bourbon and Ethiopian heirloom, grown between 1,400 and 2,100 meters, come together in a cup that’s sweet, balanced and easy to love. Every cherry was hand picked at peak holly-red ripeness. Brew a big batch for a full house, or tuck a bag under the tree for the coffee lover on your list.
Glad tidings. Comfort. Joy.

listings.title: Olympia Decaf Holiday Blend
listings.description:
The best holiday moments happen late: the second slice of pie, the last story at the table. Olympia’s Decaf Holiday Blend is made for exactly then. Grown above 1,800 meters in Colombia, this washed Caturra and Colombia lot is decaffeinated with the sugar cane (EA) process, which uses a natural compound from fermented sugar cane to gently remove caffeine while keeping the coffee’s sweetness intact. Pour it alongside dessert, any time of day.
Glad tidings. Comfort. Joy.

listings.title: Mixology Set
listings.description: The Mixology Set is designed to make great cocktails with precision and pleasure. Stir smoothly and evenly using a carefully weighted spoon, keep a tidier bar with vessels engineered for cleaner pours, and preserve the rhythm of your ritual with a shaker lid that releases cleanly. And when the last cocktail is poured, return everything to its place, ready for the next one.

listings.title: Heartstrings
listings.description:
Always featuring coffees from Ethiopia, the birthplace of coffee, Heartstrings was created to capture all the best aspects of a fruity natural while still delivering the balance and reliability of something more traditional.
Naturally processed coffees are dried with the ripe coffee cherry left intact, developing rich, jammy fruit flavors. Wonderstate pairs this with a washed coffee roasted to a sweet, cozy depth, creating a layered medium roast that brings together fruit, richness, and balance.
Jammy plum, dried fruit, and milk chocolate.

listings.title: Rebrew Espresso Series 1
listings.description:
Series 1 is designed to feel approachable from the first shot. Clear guidance and thoughtful defaults help you get started without intimidation, while the machine’s precision removes much of the variability that makes espresso feel fragile or inconsistent.
Over time, that confidence turns into control. Series 1 gives you a stable foundation to refine recipes, repeat your best results, and explore espresso more deeply. Whether you’re learning, dialing in, or settling into a daily routine, the experience stays clear, dependable, and rewarding.

listings.title: Cardamom Cloud
listings.description:
Grown at Finca El Paraíso in Colombia, this Castillo lot showcases the Bermudez family’s signature precision and experimentation in processing.
After being harvested at peak ripeness, the cherries are ozone-washed before undergoing a 72-hour double anaerobic fermentation, submerged in water with cultures in a milk medium. Once pulped, the coffee undergoes a thermal-shock wash to lock in complexity and sweetness. It’s then dried in a dehumidifier to preserve its delicate aromatics and prevent over-oxidation.
The result is a floral, spiced cup with radiant notes of cardamom, pistachio, and…

listings.title: Necessary Dark Roast
listings.description:
Necessary Dark Roast brings together two origins that complement one another beautifully. Burundian coffee contributes deep sweetness, while Peruvian coffee adds body and persistent chocolate flavors, creating a rich, balanced blend.  Sweet enough to enjoy black and bold enough to pair beautifully with milk, it's perfect served hot or iced.  Bittersweet, cocoa, and molasses.
🌎 Origin: Burundi + Peru
⚗️ Process: Washed
🔬 Variety: Field Blend
🔥 Roast: Dark
Necessary Coffee Roasters was founded in 2019 by the team behind Passenger in Lancaster, Pennsylvania. Since day one, their philosophy…

listings.title: Juan Puerta Mango
listings.description:
Created by Resident Coffee Roasters in collaboration with Juan Puerta of Sens Coffee, this light roast begins with Castillo from La Sirena in Quindío, Colombia, before undergoing an innovative mango osmotic dehydration process that builds a bold tropical profile while preserving the coffee's natural structure.
The result is a juicy, candy-like cup with remarkable clarity. Follow the Brew Guide and brew it on Aiden to bring out every layer of its vibrant fruit character.
Fruit Rollup, Mango Lollipop, Jumex Mango Nectar.
🌎 Origin: Colombia
⚗️ Process: Osmotic dehydration
🔬 Variety:…

listings.title: Moonrise
listings.description: Moonrise is crafted to showcase the harmony that comes from blending washed and naturally processed coffees. It yields a syrupy, full-bodied cup with layered sweetness and ripe fruit character, offering both depth and balance. Equally rewarding as espresso or a pourover, Moonrise delivers brightness and lingering sweetness in every cup.

listings.title: Big Joy
listings.description: Big Joy is a slightly more developed roast than Moonrise, and pairs exceptionally well with milk. We use it for all milk-based drinks in our café, where it brings richness and balance, and it brews a dynamic, layered solo shot as well. Don’t count it out as a filter option, Big Joy is equally delicious and sweet brewed on your favorite device.

listings.title: Struttura
listings.description: Struttura is a blend focused on texture. The shots are dense and syrupy, with flavors that are sweet, weighty, and dimensional. Seasonally-selected coffees produce sweet tones of dark chocolate, red fruits, and molasses, with a full, honey-like body. Struttura is easy to dial in and excellent for espresso, but it also brews a vibrant and balanced cup of drip.

listings.title: Haro Wachu Filter
listings.description:
The coffee comes from Ethiopia's Guji Zone, where smallholder families grow heirloom trees above 2,250 meters. The warm days and cold nights ripen the cherries slowly, building sugars and concentration for a light, refreshing cup that’s the perfect start to any morning.
Notes: white floral, mandarin orange, black tea.
🌎 Origin: Guji, Ethiopia
⚗️ Process: Washed
🔬 Variety: Heirloom
🔥 Roast: Light

listings.title: Haro Wachu Espresso
listings.description:
Surprisingly complex and expressive for an everyday shot, it finishes chocolateycaramel-sweet and holds up wonderfully in milk. It comes from BlendIn Coffee Club, a Houston roaster specializing in single-origin, direct-trade coffees with full traceability.
Notes: orange marmalade, milk chocolate, toffee.
🌎 Origin: Guji, Ethiopia
⚗️ Process: Washed
🔬 Variety: Heirloom
🔥 Roast: Medium

That freshness allows Series 1 to do what it does best: guide when you want support, step back when you don’t, and deliver repeatable results without feeling rigid. The process feels calmer, more intuitive, and far less intimidating.

listings.description: Our Sun Dried Natural selection comes from Kayon Mountain Estate located in Southern Guji, Ethiopia. Coffee cherries are left to dry whole with the fruit encasing the seed, or "bean", to impart flavor. The result is a cup layered with ripe, berry-like fruit tones.

listings.title: Ethiopia Sun Dried Natural
listings.description: Our Sun Dried Natural selection comes from Kayon Mountain Estate located in Southern Guji, Ethiopia. In the natural process, coffee cherries are left to dry whole with the fruit encasing the bean to impart flavor. The result is a cup layered with ripe, berry-like fruit tones.

listings.title: Robinson Salamanca
listings.description:
A Drops-exclusive Pink Bourbon from San Isidro farm in San Agustín, Colombia. Harvested over just a few days and roasted light by ilse coffee.
This lot from Robinson Salamanca's farm was harvested and processed exclusively for Fellow Drops. It’s roasted by ilse coffee, known for high-end micro lots with an emphasis on flavor clarity and full traceability, and for working primarily with smallholder producers.
This lot comes through Monkaaba, a producer-led collective in San Agustín built to give farmers like Robinson the market access, knowledge, and support they deserve. Fruit-forward and…

listings.title: Olgar Ortega
listings.description:
A rich, full-bodied Caturra from Villa Maria farm in San Agustín, Colombia, processed with meticulous attention at every step and roasted medium-light by ilse coffee.
The Ortega-Gomez family has been growing coffee in San Agustín for over sixty years. The family also helped to found Monkaaba, a producer-led collective built to give smallholder farmers in the region the market access, knowledge, and support.
This lot is a separation of Caturra harvested in August 2025. Cherries are picked at peak ripeness every three weeks, floated, then fermented in open tanks before being depulped,…

listings.title: Decaf Monkaaba
listings.description:
A light decaf Colombia sourced from producer-led collective Monkaaba and roasted by ilse in North Canaan, CT.
Founders Rebecca and Lucas say the Decaf Monkaaba is one of the best decafs they’ve ever tried. A blend of coffees from key producers in the Monkaaba producer network, it’s sweet with a pillowy mouthfeel and great balance. Citrus, brown sugar, wafer cookie.
🌎 Origin: San Agustín, Colombia
⚗️ Process: Sugarcane Washed
🔥 Roast: Light

listings.description:
Named after the way espresso “twists” as it streams from the spout of a portafilter, this medium-light blend is crafted to marry the chocolate and caramel notes of a classic espresso roast with the bright fruit notes of newer wave espressos.
🌎 Origin: South + Central America and Africa
🔬 Variety: Various
🔥 Roast: Medium-Light

listings.title: Panama Elida Estate Catuai Reserva Natural ASD
listings.description:
Founded in 1918, Lamastus Family Estates includes Elida Estate, a farm shaped by cool cloud-forest conditions and distinctive microclimates along the edge of Volcán Barú National Park. Coffee here ripens slowly in the mist, building density and layered flavor as it matures.
For this lot, ripe cherries are picked at peak sweetness and processed using Wilford Lamastus’s Anaerobic Slow Dry method. The whole cherries ferment in a sealed tank for five days, then move to raised beds for an extended, low-and-slow dry of roughly 45 to 60 days. That longer drying time helps deepen complexity and…

listings.title: Peru Umapata Community
listings.description:
A medium roast washed coffee from the Umapata community in Cusco, Peru sourced in partnership with the award-winning Yungas Coffee Project and roasted by Sacramento’s Camellia Coffee Roasters.
Bright & sweet, this crowd pleaser embodies Camellia’s mantra to create “coffees with character.”  Pull it as espresso to get caramelized sugar and mandarin jam, brew it as drip for cara cara zest and toffee.  With hot summer days ahead, it also makes an exceptional cold brew.
This coffee is connected to the Yungas Coffee Project, winner of the Sprudgie Award for Outstanding Achievement. This farmer-led…

listings.title: Monarch
listings.description:
Monarch is our most developed roast that conveys a flavor profile that we intentionally designed to work well with milk. Cream and plant based beverages mix with ease, creating a rich, decadent flavor. It involves a natural, sugar-dense coffee that binds to the fats and creates multiple complex caramelized notes during the roasting process. Look for dark chocolate and undertones of thick winey berries. Enjoy as drip or espresso.
Fulfilled by Onyx Coffee Lab

listings.title: Costa Rica, La Guaca
listings.description:
Setting aside conventional labels like light or dark, Methodical roasts each coffee to express the life it lived, including the weather, the soil, and the place it grew. This floral and tropical Red Catuai from La Guaca is a perfect example of that philosophy.
La Guaca was honey-processed by Régulo Ureña and Isabel Rojas at their world-renowned family-run micro-mill in the Chirripó region. Honey processing is a specialty in the region, striking a measured balance that we love– more mellow than a straight-up natural but incredibly flavorful.  La Guaca is named after nearby indigenous…

listings.title: Cherry Pick
listings.description:
Cherry Pick comes from Ratnagiri Estate in the Bababudangiri region, family-owned by the Patre family since 1927. Third-generation grower Ashok Patre shade-grows the cherries alongside pepper and cardamom at 1,200 meters. The cherries go through a meticulous anaerobic natural fermentation in stainless steel tanks, locking in the stone-fruit sweetness and syrupy body that defines this lot.
🌎 Origin: Ratnagiri Estate, Western Ghats, India
⚗️ Process: Anaerobic Natural
🔬 Variety: S795 / Chandragiri
🔥 Roast: Medium-Light

listings.title: Andres Martinez, Blackberry Co-Ferment
listings.description:
This week’s Drop is Andrés Martinez, a special, limited release Blackberry co-ferment from one of Colombia's most innovative producers.
Andrés Martinez is a producer whose creativity shines in the processing method—a four-day anaerobic fermentation with castilla blackberries and enology yeast, followed by an open fermentation in blackberry juice.
Roasted by Mom 'n 'em in  Cincinnati, the result is bright, eccentric, and expressive, with taste notes of macerated berry, black tea, and demerara.
🌎 Origin: Cauca, Colombia
⚗️ Process: Honey / Blackberry Co-Ferment
🔬 Variety: Caturra

listings.title: Lucia’s Guatemala
listings.description:
This week’s Drop is Lucia's Guatemala, a single-origin coffee from DOMA Coffee Roasting Company in Post Falls, ID.
The team at DOMA has spent almost 10 years working with K-Finos in Guatemala and this accessible dark roast reflects that long relationship.
During their travels to the farm, the team cups the fresh crop to find the ideal match for this profile—full-bodied with a mild acidity and light, sugary sweetness. A subtle brightness unfolds with notes of warming spices, cocoa and dried fruit.
🌎 Origin: Guatemala

listings.description:
This natural coffee from the Anasora district in Guji is a semi-forest coffee, which has been grown underneath indigenous shade trees intercropped with spices, tuber crops and false banana.
The Guji region’s unique terroir along with the farmers’ passion and acute attention to detail result in a punchy cup presenting raspberry, stone fruit and golden raisin flavors with a bright champagne acidity.
🌎 Origin: South Guji Zone, Ethiopia
⚗️ Process: Natural
🔬 Variety: Heriloom
🔥 Roast: Light

listings.title: Los Pinos Bourbon
listings.description:
Los Pinos, ‘the pines,’ takes its name from the forest canopies of Chiapas. This Bourbon is grown in the communities of Ángel Albino Corzo, where native pine trees provide shade and cooler air that slows the maturation of the cherry, building natural density and depth.
Producers hand-pick ripe cherries only, fermenting them in open tanks for 48 hours before a meticulous wash and slow dry. The result is a cup with clarity rarely seen in Mexican coffees, with notes of caramel, honey and a soft citrus finish.

reviews.author: Kim
reviews.body:
I like the concept of these, but in practice they turned out to be a bad choice for our kids. You have to push pretty hard to latch the lid - harder than my 4 & 2 year old can push. So instead, they frequently end up tipping the bottle over and spilling it. Or it looks like it's latched, but when it later inevitably gets tipped or picked up by the loop, it spills then.
The lock is also too stiff for the kids to put on by themselves.
I got the same top for me and it's fine for an adult bottle, but it's not great for kids.
Also, these bottles seem to sweat more than other water bottles, leaving condensation on whatever is next to them (particularly a problem because I want to be able to throw them in a backpack without worrying about it).

reviews.author: marcello m
reviews.body:
These are a great size, but are not fully EDC (endocrine disrupting chemical) free, I've been researching the entire market of water bottle production, and these nalgene (make sure it's the new batch numbers, the older ones contain several main EDCs, just not BPA) are the "safest" plastic ones out there.
The biggest issue is they take A HUGE amount of strength to close, I'm a decently strong adult, and I need to use both hands and my chest muscles to close them, and the little plastic catch on both my bottles are already cracked from the force.
These may be conveniently sized, and aesthetically designed for kids, but are not kid friendly.

If the hotel I am staying in also has water refilling stations, then I’ll either bring a second 16-oz bottle or a 32-oz bottle, depending on the purpose of the trip and how much space I have in my suitcase. The BPA or even the BPA-free debates have left me mostly confused. So I use stainless steel bottles whenever possible. But when I have to optimize weight and space, I turn to my Nalgene bottles.

I got it with the intention of kids backpacking and being able to attach the water filter to it, but since it is not a standard wide mouth it won't fit. We also can't swap cap types or find splash guards for them. We have one of the 12oz kids bottles and that is a standard wide mouth, so not sure why 16oz is an odd ball mouth size.
Aside from that, standard Nalgene quality and we are happy with it.

I bought two others shortly after and have never…

- you can actually see the quantity and quality of the water you’ve got

I see a lot people complaining that the straps don't last as long as they used to. That hasn't been my experience. My lid straps only ever ripped after my cats chewed on them, they seem to be obsessed with these!
Otherwise all straps and lids have all lasted me as long as the bottles so far. I hand wash only, take them hiking and do not hang them by the strap on my bag, but do occasionally hold them by the straps. Never had one rip with normal use. I like to periodically replace my lids only because I like the variety of color, and again, my cats LOVE to chew on them.
Very happy with this product!!

reviews.author: Austen Reiter
reviews.body: Ordered the color Pink and it is a different (darker) shade than what is depicted on the website.

listings.title: OTF Cap
listings.description: Fits 12, 24, & 32oz Wide Mouth Bottles.

reviews.author: Steve Cohen
reviews.body:
Easy to drink from with a wide mouth bottle, snap works well.
But the silicone seal gets moldy.
***Please sell the seal as a spare part!!!***

reviews.author: Fred
reviews.body: My wife's bottle is in great condition for being as old as it is with years old weekly use at the gym and carrying outside, yet she has stopped using it due to severe mold inside the rubber stopper. It's only been used for water. I've tried almost everything outside of bleach to no avail. It seems like the rubber is porous and allows mold to grow inside. I wanted to replace the stopper but come to find out you have to replace the entire cap. This seems like a waste. Especially if the issue comes from a poor material design in the first place.

reviews.author: Lasse
reviews.body:
We have 3 OTF bottles (out of 6 total Nalgene bottles)
2 of the OTF bottles have moldy lid seals even though they are washed frequently. Unfortunately you can’t buy a new seal and will therefore have to replace the entire lid. That is not very sustainable is it….

reviews.author: Cheryl
reviews.body:
Love the design except the silicone seal. Even run through the dishwasher regularly, it gets moldy! Yuck,! I end up relaxing the whole lid because I can't find just the silicone seal to purchase separately!
We've been using this style bottle for 13? Years. We've lost a few and had to replace lids but only 1 lid actually broke on all that time and all the bottoms are fine if not a bit scratched and scuffed. I love that I can put them in the dishwasher!

reviews.author: Smitha
reviews.body: I cannot keep this bloody thing closed. The metal bit can be really hard to snap into place, and without it, the top can’t stay closed on its own and drenches my stuff multiple times a day. This is an over-designed fail, rare and surprising considering Nalgene’s classic and successful simplicity. I’ll be replacing it with a screw-top lid.

listings.title: Narrow Mouth Cap
listings.description: Replacement closure. Fits all Narrow Mouth and Oasis bottles.

reviews.author: Patrick McMullin
reviews.body: I replaced the one that was originally on it for the palm one!{The Narrow cap fits perfectly on my Nalgene 32 oz. Water Bottle,and is groovy!}Surfs up dudes,and lassie's!

reviews.author: CJ Parker
reviews.body: My Nalgene 32 oz narrow mouth water bottle has been wonderful! I recent had the cap of my water bottle break, but I don't blame nalgene for that. I contacted warranty support and they got it replaced quickly! Highly recommend this product and company!

reviews.author: David Einreinhofer
reviews.body: The only reason I need to replace the lid for my small mouth Water bottle is cause i was a dope and it got damaged in the dishwasher. I have had this water bottle and 2 others for over 20 years. Best bottles I've ever owned.

reviews.author: Harrison Watts
reviews.body: The cap to my nalgene broke. This cap is not designed to lift the water bottle when full ( how mine broke ) I have only had this water bottle for half of a year and am sad that it's already damaged.

reviews.author: Joshua Stickley
reviews.body: It is an exact replacement part so of course it works perfectly. Installation was easy, just press the lid’s strap ring down working it around the flange on the bottle’s neck, and done! This part can be found on other websites for slightly cheaper if you are an extreme tight ass.

listings.description: Made from HDPE, a super light-weight material perfect for when you’re packing light.

reviews.author: Dianne Dalombe
reviews.body: These bottles are NOT made in the USA! Where are they made?!

reviews.author: Becca
reviews.body: Nalgene quality is good, but why do these bottles only measure 30 oz if they are supposed to hold 32?

reviews.author: Anno
reviews.body: Have been using these for backpacking since the 1960’s. Best because the softer plastic is less likely to crack if dropped on a rock. Plus my “kids” and I use (sturdy) stickers to tell them apart from each other on the trail. And they’ve lasted through several dishwasher loads.

reviews.author: Steve P
reviews.body: Simple and durable, love this water bottle! I like that it's dishwasher safe and can't beat the never-leak screw top. Gotta love affordable, high-quality products that last.

reviews.author: kurt maurer
reviews.body: In the 1980's I did a lot of rock climbing and used these bottles to cary my water for the day. In the summer I would freeze 2 and refrigerate 2 and cary them in insulated pouches (lived in Las Vegas, NV). I still have some of these 32oz. bottles and one 64oz. There great for the outdoors and have held up very well. These days I still use them for camping trips 30 years later.

listings.description: Nalgene’s classic neoprene sleeve. Fits snugly around 32-ounce bottle, making it easy to carry and sweat-free.

reviews.author: Blair L.
reviews.body: There is nothing else out there like this product! I freeze part of my Nalgene bottle with oral rehydration solution in it each night. This type sleeve prevents sweating which is important when I sit it on a table top. Too, it helps it to stay frozen longer.

reviews.author: Michael S
reviews.body: This is an excellent way to keep the condensation to a minimum while having a full bottle of cold water while sitting at a desk or just riding around in a car doing errands.

reviews.author: Cori
reviews.body: How do you clean/ wash this fabric?

listings.title: 10oz Flask
listings.description: Fits in pockets and lays flat. An all-in-one shot-glass, bottle and sharing vessel.

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.body: I went through some of the complaints about what some call the "case" or "sleeve". This accessory is neither. The black removable cup, fits over the screw cap, should be a clue. This was designed as a container to carry alternative to water liquids (otherwise known as alcohol). One measures the alcohol out with the cap attachment (it holds one traditional jigger measurement), then pours it into the larger cup (some call it a sleeve or case). Then mixes it with Coke, Dr Pepper, water, etc. BEHOLD, a mixed alcohol beverage!

reviews.author: Tango Mike
reviews.body:
BEST Commuter/EDC bottle because of EZ slip sheath!
A lot of comments about the sheath/sharing cup not staying attached to the flask. For my application, carrying hydration in a crowded EDC or laptop bag, having the sharing cup stay in place in the bag for easy return of the tapered flask is a definite win that is not offered by any other manufacturer like those A5 designs. Jamming the oasis or cylinder bottles into a bag that has clothing or electronics in it is a PITA. I Just wish the flask came in 450/500 ml and 750 ml with the same lightweight design. I currently carry two in the meantime or maybe will try the oasis with a Natick stove or cup for the same effect but a heavier solution.

reviews.author: Beth
reviews.body:
I bought 2 and loved them, and have had many people question where they are from/where to get them (& was I drinking straight vodka from it 😂). Loved them until the cap detached from one and went missing 😔
It was in the side pouch of my bag, and I have never had this issue with any other bottle.
Unable to find a replacement cap.
I always had both bottles filled when out for the day, and can now only use one. Would recommend having the cap attached as other bottles have.

reviews.author: Marty W
reviews.body: This is the second time I purchased this flask. I really like it for its slim profile; it fits nicely inside a jacket pocket and isn't too noticeable. However, like a few others who have written reviews, the fact that the outer case does not fit snugly is an annoyance. I'll still give it 5 stars, but some simple redesign is warranted if Nalgene really feels the case to be necessary. I don't think it's necessary. I fixed the issue by placing a few self-stick felt pads on the inside of the case, close to the top edge. That seems to do the trick to keep the case on the flask itself.

reviews.author: Daily 3 mile Hiker
reviews.body: Just stick one in your pocket, go outside and have fun. This bulk-free bottle shape is absolutely the best.

Because it is subtly stretchy and has a flat bottom, you can fill it without it popping open as traditional ziplock bags do. Bring it back soon! I need to use them for gifts!!

listings.description:
Raise your spirits. All of them.
The classic red party cup has come back from the dead, this time made of silicone that won’t crack, crumple or end up in the trash by sunrise.
It’s built for haunted house parties, graveyard gatherings and whatever’s bubbling in your cauldron. Booze, boos or a cold brew to survive the morning after, we don’t judge what goes in it.
This one’s yours till death do you part.

listings.title: Dark Spirits Chocolate Rum Ball Coffee
listings.description:
Awaken the spirits within.
Aged in oak rum barrels and cast into the flames to awaken the spirit within: Meet Barrel-Aged Chocolate Rum Ball. This specialty coffee is carefully crafted by manually turning rum barrels filled with high-quality green coffee beans for weeks at a time.
During this aging process, the coffee absorbs the flavors and aromas of the rum. The rum barrel-aged coffee is then roasted medium and mixed with natural flavors to create the sweet, chocolate and rum-forward coffee you fell in love with when it went by Barrel Brand Chocolate Rum Ball.
*This product is…

listings.title: Dark Spirits 8oz Klean Kanteen
listings.description:
Summon your brew.
This limited-edition 8oz Klean Kanteen wears the Dark Spirits mark in a deep mystic plum, holding your coffee (or something a little stronger) until the next sign appears.
Ask the board if you need a refill. Hint: the answer is always yes.

listings.title: Dark Spirits Klean Kanteen Bundle
listings.description:
A little coffee, a little chaos.
Complete with everything you need to dabble in the dark arts (minus the Ouija board), this limited-edition bundle was made for the bold souls who like their coffee strong and their supernatural encounters a little too real.
Just remember: some things are better left undisturbed—like you before you've had your first cup.

listings.title: Dark Spirits Long Sleeve
listings.description:
The spirits have spoken, and they said “more coffee.”
This limited-edition Dark Spirits long sleeve brings the planchette front and center, surrounded by sun, moon, and stars, with celestial details running down the sleeves.
Rich burgundy, soft fit, and made for chilly mornings, late-night séances, and everything in between.
*Size M and 2XL may see slight delays in fulfillment and will be shipped separately from other items in your order.

listings.title: Fired Up for Fall Matchbook
listings.description:
Set the mood, pumpkin.
Perfect for the fall fiends that have been waiting all year to get their hands on everything pumpkin, this limited-edition, pocket-sized matchbook was made to light your jack-o'-lantern or favorite Fall candles.
Strike a match, put on a pot of Pumpkin Chai and get ready for the room to smell like you just baked a homemade pie—because apparently setting something on fire is the appropriate way to celebrate sweater weather.
*This product is available for Ground shipping only and not available for purchase outside of the Continental US.

listings.title: Chaos and Coffee Pet Tag Set
listings.description:
Sit. Stay. Raise Hell.
Not every dog is a lap dog—some are four-legged agents of chaos fueled by caffeine-adjacent energy and an unwavering commitment to barking at absolutely nothing.
This durable metal set clips onto your pet's collar and your keys, making it perfect for loyal companions, professional troublemakers, and certified good boys alike. Featuring a Death Wish Coffee inspired meme on each, there's no easier way to let strangers know which one of you is fueled by coffee and which is powered by chaos.

listings.title: Hell Hound Pet Bandana
listings.description:
Big dog energy.
Whether you have a pocket-sized pooch, a "guard dog" that wouldn't hurt a fly or a hell hound that's truly worthy of a "beware of dog" sign, this limited-edition bandana is bound to make them think they're the star of the show regardless of their weight class.
May cause zoomies and heightened levels of excitement that could result in them keeping you up at night—we'll be ready with coffee.

listings.title: Hell Hound Mug
listings.description:
Guardian of the grind.
Legend has it a 3-headed hound with red eyes and a fiery temper guards the gates of the underworld and never sleeps. Perfect for anyone that can relate, this limited-edition, handcrafted mug is your loyal companion for the darkest hours—whether that's a 5 a.m. alarm or a 3 p.m. slump.
Made in collaboration with Deneen Pottery and best paired with coffee strong enough to wake the dead (or just the dead inside).

listings.title: Gingerdead Single-Serve Pods
listings.description:
Ginger? Oh snap.
Nothing says holiday season like warm gingerbread on a cold winter’s morning. Our limited edition blend infuses medium roasted robusta and arabica beans with a festive natural flavor mix of ginger, cinnamon, clove and molasses for a cup that captures the spirit of the season in every sip. Candied ginger provides a fiery kick to the tastebuds followed by a cozy cinnamon hug.
This sweetly spiced blend is sure to warm even the coldest bah-humbug’s heart this holiday. Pro tip—add cream and sugar to dial up this bold holiday flavor to the max.
*Single-serve pods are compatible…

listings.title: Gingerdead Coffee
listings.description:
Ginger? Oh snap.
Nothing says holiday season like warm gingerbread on a cold winter’s morning. listings.title: Crossbones Klean Kanteen Mug
listings.description:
METAL TO THE CORE.
For when you need to get cracking while you crush your coffee. Serving on-the-go readiness in a shadowy colorway that can withstand even the loudest of living. So turn it up, hit the gas and do what you gotta do. Your coffee will be hot and ready in the Crossbones Klean Kanteen Mug.

listings.title: White Chocolate Pistachio Klean Kanteen (20oz)
listings.description:
Sweet on the outside, strong all the way through.
Whether you're chasing Fall foliage or just making it to the other side of a Monday, this limited-edition Klean Kanteen is built to keep 20oz of your favorite brews piping hot or ice cold for hours.
Wrapped in white chocolate skulls and pistachio-green detail, it's the perfect way to carry the creamy, decadent flavor of White Chocolate Pistachio (or any of our other bold brews) wherever life takes you.
AVAILABLE EXCLUSIVELY AT DEATHWISHCOFFEE.COM

listings.title: White Chocolate Pistachio Coffee
listings.description:
Dessert called. Coffee answered.
You could call this coffee, but we call it a mic drop in a mug.
Warm, toasted pistachios meet sweet white chocolate in this smooth brew for a flavor that's earthy, sweet and entirely unapologetic.
Ethically sourced from top to bottom, with Certified Fair Trade & Organic arabica and robusta beans and only natural flavors, kick the door in on decadence with a clean conscience.
Matching Klean Kanteen sold separately.
AVAILABLE EXCLUSIVELY AT DEATHWISHCOFFEE.COM

listings.title: White Chocolate Pistachio Ground Bundle
listings.description:
Bold flavor meets on-the-go convenience.
What's better than a mug-full of warm, toasted pistachio and sweet white chocolate? Pairing it with a 20oz Klean Kanteen wrapped in White Chocolate Pistachio flavor skulls so you can take your new favorite flavor wherever life might lead you.
Whether you're chasing Fall foliage or just making it to the other side of a Monday, this limited-edition bundle promises to keep you fueled through it all.
AVAILABLE EXCLUSIVELY AT DEATHWISHCOFFEE.COM
*This product is excluded from the National Coffee Day sale.

listings.title: Fight or Flight Sampler Kit
listings.description:
Commitment issues? Perfect.
Why choose one when you can try four? Whether you're taste-testing our canned lattes, building the ultimate coffee flight, or figuring out which beer deserves a permanent spot in your fridge, this sampler board was made for bold decisions and questionable levels of curiosity.
Complete with four tasting glasses and a wooden serving board, this set lets you label each pour so there's no confusion between "new favorite" and "never again." Gather your friends, trust your taste buds, and conduct your highly scientific research one sip at a time.
Ready to find your…

listings.title: Hidden In Plain Sight Snapback
listings.description:
Nothing to see here.
Whether you're slipping through the woods or sneaking up on your to-do list, this limited-edition snapback is the perfect companion for flying under the radar and avoiding any unwanted distractions in the process.
Throw it on, pour a cup of your favorite brews and get ready to conquer the day like it never saw you coming.
*Full collection sold separately.

listings.title: Wild at Heart Beanie
listings.description:
Answer the call of the wild.
Whether you're deep in the woods in pursuit of a Red Stag or just stepping outside on a crisp fall morning, this limited-edition beanie is made for days when the temperature drops but your standards don't.
Featuring an earthy brown finish with a faux-leather patch, it's the perfect layer for whatever adventure—or aggressively overbooked Saturday—you've got planned.
Throw it on, grab your coffee and get out there. The wild is calling.
*Full collection sold separately.

listings.title: Call of the Wild Mug
listings.description:
The chase never ends.
Inspired by the elusive nature and enduring power of the stag, this limited-edition mug is a symbol of mystery, strength and the thrill of the chase.
Luckily, for those of us that can't shed and regrow our antlers every year and come back stronger the next, there's coffee. So pour another cup and declare it personal growth—because when it comes to great coffee, the pursuit never ends.

listings.title: Odin's Deck of Destiny Playing Cards
listings.description:
A little luck, a little divine intervention.
Inspired by the Allfather himself, this limited-edition deck of cards brings a little Norse mythology to your next coffee break or game night.
Whether you're battling for bragging rights, passing the time while you wait for your coffee to finish brewing or simply want to add a custom deck worthy of the gods to your collection, may the odds be in your favor.

listings.title: Gates of Valhalla Long Sleeve
listings.description:
Relentless by Nature. Caffeinated by Choice.
Forged for those who trade axes for ambition and shields for coffee that's as strong as any line of defense, this limited-edition tee is for the ones who don't wait for glory to come to them, they brew it.
Infused with the same unforgiving energy as Valhalla Java Odinforce Blend and Single-Serve Pods , it's proof that Valhalla isn't just for the fallen—it's for the every day warriors fighting to get by one cup at a time.

listings.title: Daily Grind Women's Corduroy Workwear Jacket
listings.description:
Embrace the daily grind.
So soft it’s almost criminal but tough enough to survive the hardest of days, this limited-edition workwear jacket doesn't shy away from the daily grind.
Whether you're braving the elements or kicking your feet up by the fire with a mug-full of bold, delicious brews after a long day, it'll keep you warm down to your bones.

listings.title: Rough Cut Canvas Jacket
listings.description:
